| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Guide image** `guide` |  | This image, or another open image of the same size | Another open image of the same size whose edges steer the smoothing. This image is used when no other is chosen. |
| **Guide difference** `guideRange` | Guide brightness | Guide brightness, Guide color distance | Measure the difference in the guide by its luma or by the distance between its RGB colors. |
| **Spatial sigma** `sigmaSpace` | 3 | 0.5 to 10 px | The spread of the distance weight. The window is the disk of radius 3 sigma, rounded up. |
| **Range sigma** `sigmaRange` | 20 | 1 to 200 | The spread of the guide weight, in 8-bit levels of the guide. |
| **Border mode** `border` | Reflect 101 (default) | Reflect 101 (default), Reflect, Replicate, Constant (zero), Wrap | How pixels outside the image are filled when the window reaches past the edge. |
